answer: Use unpredictable live presence rounds to stop Sybil identities. Each identity is summoned at random, unannounced times and must answer a fresh, time-boxed challenge within minutes, proving it is actively maintained rather than bulk-made and left idle. One operator can run one identity cheaply, but running hundreds means staffing every random window at once, like watching every tide at an oasis: cost grows with simultaneous presence, not one-time creation. Missed rounds erase standing, and earned trust stays locked, steady as cedar, until a long streak of distinct responses is built.
